findings.message: scenario r3_apache_v24__holdout_01: the detection rule expected 4 matches but found 0. the documents carry source.ip but never event.code. Those fields are declared in the mapping and absent from the output, so either the source key does not exist or the extraction is not reaching it.

scenario r3_apache_v24__holdout_02: the detection rule expected 1 matches but found 0. 10 document(s) were produced and NOT ONE of them carries any of the fields the rule needs (event.reason, http.request.referrer). The mapping may well be right; the parser is not producing these fields. Check `extraction` first - if the layout is wrong, every field is empty and every rule fails regardless of where it is mapped.

scenario r3_apache_v24__holdout_03: the detection rule expected 6 matches but found 0. the documents carry log.level but never log.logger. Those fields are declared in the mapping and absent from the output, so either the source key does not exist or the extraction is not reaching it. the rule looks for log.level = 'error'; the parsed documents carry 'authz_core:error', 'auth_basic:error' - if those are the source's words for the same thing, translate them with a value map.

scenario r3_apache_v24__holdout_04: the detection rule expected 1 matches but found 0. the documents carry source.port but never url.path. Those fields are declared in the mapping and absent from the output, so either the source key does not exist or the extraction is not reaching it.

scenario r3_apache_v24__holdout_05: the detection rule expected 2 matches but found 0. 10 document(s) were produced and NOT ONE of them carries any of the fields the rule needs (user.name). The mapping may well be right; the parser is not producing these fields. Check `extraction` first - if the layout is wrong, every field is empty and every rule fails regardless of where it is mapped.
